stop_rules.note: a 429 pauses 5 minutes and the same request is tried once more; a second 429 in a row stops the run with the cursor saved; no retry loop

privacy_rules: no account, portfolio, order, fill, position or key endpoint (the runner refuses them)
no Authorization header, no key, no cookie
response bodies go to scratch outside the repository and are never committed; only the status read log is committed
purpose: Remainder to the protocol cap of 1,600. The registered stop rule ends it earlier: the first 200 read block in which a rule has 130 trades by the rule (R1 expected near 470 total reads, about 520 reads for 30 held-out R1 trades; R2 is not expected to get there under 1,600). Review at each checkpoint with `python3 -I src/scalper/mentpersist1.py plan` counts.
will_not_decide: does not decide MENTPERSIST1 by itself: the rules, gates, committed cut and held-out read-once marker stay in the protocol and mentpersist1.py
reads no outcome of a target market; no outcome is scored by the runner
does not touch the 500 held markets (already in data/ment1.sqlite)
ingest: python3 -I src/scalper/pulljobs_ingest.py MENTPERSIST1_B_1300  (loads the scratch files into data/ment1.sqlite candle and done, exactly as mentpersist1 fetch does)
order_note: requests are the first 1600 of the ascending-md5 new-market pool after the 505 already in `done` (plan order of mentpersist1.py)
stop_review: at each checkpoint run the block count (counts()) and stop for good when R1 or R2 has total >= 130 trades
